annotations.title: Korea policy feed in English: latest government policy and legislative notices with English briefs

description: Use when an agent tracks South Korean government policy, regulation or draft legislation in English. Input: optional q (keyword, Korean or English), date (YYYY-MM-DD KST), limit (1-20, default 5). Output: JSON items with Korean title, official link, published time and English brief {title_en, summary_en, agency_en, category, key_points}. Machine translation; check the official page. Example: ?q=safety&limit=5 Price: $0.0045 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

date.description: Only items published that KST day

q.description: Keyword filter, Korean or English: English terms match whole words, common topics match both languages (AI = 인공지능); Korean title hits first

name: kr_policy_latest
